betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Nodes have no recipe and no cost: with a bound terminal, right-click any ground to plant a Quantum Node.

Each node bridges into the anchored controller's grid through a virtual connection, so adjacent AE2 devices join the network directly — vanilla cable distance limits simply do not apply. Each connection carries dense-cable capacity: 32 channels, and the node itself consumes none. Idle draw is 10 AE/t by default.

Nodes work within the same dimension only. Shift+right-click a node with the terminal to destroy it (no drops).
